revenueProvenance.basis: Issuer consolidated revenue in the cited presentation. FY2025 and FY2026 and the latest H1 comparative are continuing operations; netIncome is total profit attributable to owners, including discontinued operations. Never add gaming tax. Lottery technology/equipment exposure is not a casino concession.
revenueProvenance.operatingIncomeBasis: Explicit issuer operating profit/loss subtotal, including impairment, deconsolidation and debt-extinguishment gains as reported, not recurring-core earnings.
revenueProvenance.businessScope: Lottery systems, terminal equipment and gaming-product technology/operation services in China. Revenue excludes disposed/discontinued activities where the statement is re-presented.

annual.notes: Operating profit includes HK$182,373 thousand gain on extinguishment of financial liabilities; total attributable profit includes HK$6,534 thousand discontinued profit. Not recurring operating profitability.

halfYear.notes: Report compares six months ended December 2023 with six months ended June 2022, not December 2022.
Discontinued-operation profit/loss is nil in this period; owners' total loss is therefore not distorted by discontinued earnings.

limitations: 1371-continuing-excluding-ecotourism is common to FY2025/FY2026 and December 2024/2025 H1: both latest reports exclude ecotourism from continuing revenue. This supports aligned FY-minus-H1 and TTM income, not adding differently restated per-share observations. Earlier un-restated ecotourism-inclusive records remain outside this group; the irregular fiscal transition still requires actual-date and period-length checks.
Provider annual date 2025-12-31 is not the official FY2026 end; FY2026 ends 2026-06-30. Do not rename every December provider observation: December 2025 is independently a six-month interim period.
FY2023 is 18 months, 2022-01-01 through 2023-06-30. The 2022 second interim is twelve months, not H1 or a separate audited FY; retained separately in interimPeriods.
Provider H1 2011 and 2012 are not covered by the supplied manifest or its filing index, which starts at interim 2014; no unsupported old H1 values supplied.
Null D&A denotes no complete compatible expense total reviewed; no EBITDA-minus-EBIT inference. Annual D&A excludes capitalised depreciation; FY2025 D&A uses continuing note components 853+761+3325.

Comparability groups conservatively link only documented compatible comparative presentations and durations; no invented restatement bridge. EPS is as printed in the cited report, including report-specific share restatements, in HKD per share.
